SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Br. /Special,
REPORT
File No. ____
Date. May 11, 1936.

Subject. Handley Gordon VALE, communication from Johannesburg.

Made by D.P.S. Henchman Forwarded by. _J. J. C_ [签名]

Inquiries made with reference to Mr. H. G. Vale have elicited the information that he is a British subject born of missionary parents in Chengtu on 10th August 1907. He is in possession of British passport No. 11049 issued in Shanghai on 19th September 1934, but at the time of his departure for South Africa he was not registered at the British Consulate. In November 1925 Vale joined Imperial Chemical Industries in Shanghai and later was transferred to Harbin and from there to Chungking where he held the post of manager for two years. He returned to Shanghai in 1933 and was employed in the head office of Imperial Chemical Industries until 30th November 1935 when together with twenty other employees he lost his position owing to a redundancy of staff. His ex-employers speak very highly of him and have expressed their willingness to furnish anything that may be necessary in the way of a testimonial. Mr. Perry, the Imperial Chemical Industries employee referred to in Vale's letter, when interviewed stated that in his opinion Vale's reason for approaching him for a reference and not the Company, was a matter of pride, pride that had been hurt by an apparent unreasonable termination of his services.

Vale has no police record.

（左侧批注：DBR / 12 - 36）

P.A to Commr
Information
[签名: Henchman]
D. P. S.

[签名: Chas Richardson]
Officer i/c Special Branch. Off - I/B

档案号 ____
日期：1936年5月11日。

事由：汉德利·戈登·韦尔，来自约翰内斯堡的来函。

由 D.P.S. 亨奇曼呈报 转交人：_J. J. C_ [签名]

就 H. G. 韦尔先生进行的查询获悉，他是一名英国臣民，1907年8月10日出生于成都，父母为传教士。他持有1934年9月19日在上海签发的第11049号英国护照，但在其启程前往南非时，并未在英国领事馆登记。1925年11月，韦尔加入上海卜内门化学工业公司，后调往哈尔滨，继而调往重庆，在那里担任经理职务两年。他于1933年返回上海，在卜内门化学工业公司总部任职，直至1935年11月30日，因人员冗余，他与其他二十名雇员一同失业。他的前雇主对他评价极高，并表示愿意提供任何形式的必要推荐信。韦尔信中提到的卜内门化学工业公司雇员佩里先生在接受问询时表示，他认为韦尔向他而非向公司寻求推荐信是出于自尊心，这种自尊心因其服务被看似不合理地终止而受到了伤害。

韦尔无警务记录。

（左侧批注：DBR / 12 - 36）

呈警务处长
供参考
[签名: 亨奇曼]
D. P. S.

[签名: 查斯·理查森]
特务科主管警官。 Off - I/B
